title: Make use of daylight
description: When it suits the room and your routine, use available daylight before switching on electric lights.
recommendation: Open curtains or use a well-lit area for daytime tasks where privacy, glare, and safety allow.
impact: The effect depends on daylight, the room, and how the lights are used. No specific saving is guaranteed.

title: Switch off lights you do not need
description: Notice when a light is left on in an empty room.
recommendation: Consider switching off lights when a room is unoccupied, where safe and appropriate.
impact: Any change depends on the lamp, its power rating, and how long it would otherwise be on.

title: Compare lighting labels
description: Product labels help you compare lighting options for the brightness and fitting you need.
recommendation: When replacing a bulb, check its packaging and follow the fitting manufacturer's guidance.
impact: Suitability and energy use vary by product and room; compare the information on the products themselves.

title: Switch off fans in empty rooms
description: Fans circulate air for people in a room; they do not need to be on in an unoccupied space.
recommendation: Turn off a fan when you leave a room if nobody else needs it.
impact: The effect depends on the fan rating and the time it would otherwise run.

title: Choose a comfortable fan speed
description: A fan's speed setting can affect its power use and the airflow you experience.
recommendation: Use a setting that feels comfortable, and follow the fan's instructions.
impact: The result varies with fan design and setting; check the product information for your model.

title: Use air-conditioning thoughtfully
description: Cooling needs differ between rooms, households, and weather conditions.
recommendation: Choose a comfortable setting, close doors and windows while cooling, and follow the manufacturer's maintenance guidance.
impact: There is no single setting or savings amount that suits every room or appliance.

title: Close the refrigerator door promptly
description: Keeping the refrigerator door closed helps it maintain its intended internal conditions.
recommendation: Decide what you need before opening the door, then close it securely.
impact: Appliance design, condition, and household use all affect energy consumption.

title: Keep refrigerator vents clear
description: Refrigerators need appropriate airflow around and inside the appliance.
recommendation: Follow the manufacturer's instructions for spacing, cleaning, and safe storage.
impact: Use the manual for your specific model; installation and maintenance needs vary.

title: Boil the water you need
description: The amount of water heated affects how long an electric kettle needs to run.
recommendation: Use the kettle's minimum fill guidance and boil an appropriate amount for your needs.
impact: The effect depends on the water volume, starting temperature, and kettle.

title: Review standby habits
description: Some devices continue to draw power while waiting in standby; behavior varies by product.
recommendation: Check the device manual and consider switching off equipment at its power control when it is safe and practical.
impact: Not every device uses power in the same way when off or on standby. Avoid switching off equipment that needs to remain powered.

title: Plan laundry loads
description: Washing machine programmes and load sizes are designed for particular amounts of laundry.
recommendation: Follow the manual's load guidance and choose a suitable programme for the items being washed.
impact: The best programme depends on the clothes, machine, and household needs; avoid overloading.

title: Group ironing where practical
description: Planning similar household tasks together may reduce repeated setup and warm-up time.
recommendation: If it fits your routine, iron several items in one session and follow the appliance safety instructions.
impact: Any difference depends on your iron, how often you use it, and your routine.

title: Read appliance labels and manuals
description: A product's label or manual is more relevant to your home than a general example wattage.
recommendation: Use the specific model's rating or manufacturer energy information when estimating appliance use.
impact: A rating improves the input to an estimate; it does not make the result an exact bill.

title: Review appliances left switched on
description: A quick check can help you notice equipment that does not need to stay on.
recommendation: Switch off or unplug equipment only when the manufacturer says it is safe and it does not need to remain on.
impact: Some devices must remain powered for safety, cooling, communications, or other functions; check before switching off.
